# monotaur_notification_policy (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur notification policy by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_notification_policy" "production" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the notification policy to look up.

### Read-Only

- `channel_ids` (List of String) IDs of the notification channels the policy targets.
- `component_ids` (List of String) IDs of the components the policy matches on.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the policy was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy matches events.
- `label_ids` (List of String) IDs of the labels the policy matches on.
- `minimum_severity` (String) The least severe alarm the policy matches (`Info`, `Warning`, `Error` or `Critical`), or null for any.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) IDs of the monitors the policy matches on.
- `name` (String) The display name of the policy.
- `repeat_interval_minutes` (Number) How often, in minutes, an open and unacknowledged alarm is notified again, or null for no repeat.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the policy was last updated.
